subject.title: fix: bound gateway model pricing cache

question: Should OpenClaw accept a fixed 4,096-entry, recency-biased retention policy for gateway model pricing when an incoming catalog exceeds the cache bound?
rationale: The patch fixes unbounded memory growth, but its chosen cap deliberately changes which older model-pricing rows survive unusually large catalog refreshes; repository policy treats fallback and compatibility behavior as maintainer-visible choices.

options.title: Accept the bounded retention policy
options.body: Land the state-boundary cap after refreshing the branch and confirming the focused runtime proof and required checks on the actual merge head.

options.title: Choose different cache semantics
options.body: Request a different capacity or eviction contract if preserving more catalog rows is more important than the proposed memory ceiling.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded retention policy
recommendation.body: Land the state-boundary cap after refreshing the branch and confirming the focused runtime proof and required checks on the actual merge head.
